_description: F14 — THE single controlled taxonomy bridging the Employee Services catalog vocabulary
(frontend/src/features/services/serviceConfig.ts service keys) to the HR Policy Builder's
_CANONICAL_KEYS). Both sides MUST read this file — never redeclare a service→benefit map
in cases_read.py and the caps/compare resolver in policy_config_matrix_service.py) and
Services-catalog category is missing here or if a mapped benefit_key is not canonical.
_services_note: Every Services-catalog key (serviceConfig.ts ServiceKey) MUST appear here. The value is the
list of canonical policy-config benefit_keys whose published caps constitute the service's
budget. An empty list is an EXPLICIT declaration that no policy-matrix benefit exists for
the service (honest no_cap, never a false green tick). 'tax' is a legacy intake-only
service key kept for older draft_json['services'] rows.
_aliases_note: Alternate vocabularies that older rows / other surfaces use for the same service:
serviceConfig backendKeys (living_areas, insurance), the legacy intake vocabulary
(moving, immigration, temp_housing, spouse_career) and the RFQ item vocabulary
(temporary_housing). Each alias resolves to exactly one canonical service key above.
_modules_note: policy_config_matrix_service.py) — the serviceModule filter of GET /api/policy-config/caps.
